TraitInfo.PyOnCityLost: bConquest and createPartisans(pPlayer, pCity, 2 + iPopulation, iCultureLevel)
TraitInfo.PyOnTechAcquired: (bFirst and gainGold(pPlayer, 25), countEvery(pPlayer, eTrait, 3) and createUnits(pPlayer, 'UNITCLASS_SCOUT', 1, capitalPlot(pPlayer)), showMessage(pPlayer, 'TXT_KEY_CLAUDE_TEST_HOOK_LOG', ('PyOnTechAcquired', infoDescription('Tech', eTech) + ', bFirst ' + str(bFirst) + ', counter ' + str(pPlayer.getTraitCounter(eTrait)))))
TraitInfo.PyOnGreatPersonBorn: (gainTraitForTurns(pPlayer, 'TRAIT_TEST_TEMPORARY', 5), pCity.isNone() or addCulture(pCity, 100), showMessage(pPlayer, 'TXT_KEY_CLAUDE_TEST_HOOK_LOG', ('PyOnGreatPersonBorn', pUnit.getName() + ', ' + cityName(pCity))))
TraitInfo.PyOnWarDeclared: (bAggressor and gainGold(pPlayer, 50), bAggressor or createCityConscripts(pPlayer, 3), showMessage(pPlayer, 'TXT_KEY_CLAUDE_TEST_HOOK_LOG', ('PyOnWarDeclared', gc.getTeam(iOtherTeam).getName() + ', bAggressor ' + str(bAggressor))))
TraitInfo.PyOnEraChanged: (createUnits(pPlayer, 'UNITCLASS_ENGINEER', 1, capitalPlot(pPlayer)), showMessage(pPlayer, 'TXT_KEY_CLAUDE_TEST_HOOK_LOG', ('PyOnEraChanged', infoDescription('Era', iOldEra) + ' -> ' + infoDescription('Era', eEra))))

TraitInfo.PyOnBeginTurn: chooseGreatPeopleByCalendar(pPlayer, eTrait, None, 200, 2012) and showMessage(pPlayer, 'TXT_KEY_CLAUDE_TEST_HOOK_LOG', ('PyOnBeginTurn', 'year ' + str(CyGame().getTurnYear(CyGame().getGameTurn() + 1)) + ', (chosen, pending) ' + str(greatPersonChoiceState(pPlayer, eTrait))))

TraitInfo.PyOnCityAcquired: bConquest and pCity.getConscriptUnit() != -1 and pPlayer.initUnit(pCity.getConscriptUnit(), pCity.getX(), pCity.getY(), UnitAITypes.NO_UNITAI, DirectionTypes.DIRECTION_SOUTH)

TraitInfo.PyOnCityLost: bConquest and createPartisans(pPlayer, pCity, 2 + iPopulation, iCultureLevel)

TraitInfo.PyOnCityFounded: [isCoastalCity(pCity) and (isOverseasCity(pCity) or isNewWorldCity(pCity)) and addBuilding(pCity, 'BUILDINGCLASS_LIGHTHOUSE'), isCoastalCity(pCity) and isNewWorldCity(pCity) and addBuilding(pCity, 'BUILDINGCLASS_HARBOR')]
